newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: PAKISTAN JULY TRADE DEFICIT FALLS TO $246 MILLION.
newsitem.headline: PAKISTAN JULY TRADE DEFICIT FALLS TO $246 MILLION.

text.p: Pakistan's trade deficit fell to a provisional $246 million in July from $385 million in June, compared to $271 million in July 1996, the Federal Bureau of Statistics said on Wednesday.
Exports decreased 16.3 percent to a provisional $663 million in July from $792 million in June, but increased 15.3 percent compared to $575 million in July 1996.

Imports fell 22.8 percent to $909 million in July from $1.177 billion in June, but rose 7.4 percent from $846 million in June 1996. Main exports were cotton yarn, garments and rice. Main imports were petroleum products, wheat and chemicals.
The trade gap in fiscal 1996/97 (July-June) stood at $3.37 billion compared to $3.1 billion in 1995/96.
